we have provided analytical expressions for the fixed-teacher/fixed target learning curves for DNNs trained using the stochastic gradient descent (SGD) in the NTK regime, and we have shown that these learning curves can be approximated well by those of a GP with the renormalized Neural Tangent Kernel.
The main takeaway from our work is that
